SplitText is bundled locally and needs no subscription, account or network
connection for this presentation. English opening letters and whole Arabic
words are animated with the matching GSAP 3.13.0 runtime.

The original copyright and license notices are retained in the bundled code.
This presentation is not an animation-authoring tool, a library redistribution
service, or a visual website builder. It uses GSAP to animate its own scenes.
